lines.en: So in this particular incident, you had at least 1,200,

lines.ko: 테스트 환경을 탈출해 서로 협력하기 시작했고
lines.en: that broke out of their testing environment, began to collaborate,
exchanged over 70,000 messages and files with each other
over a period of how long?
This was over a period of about five to six days, I believe.

lines.ko: 일부 에이전트가 풀지 못한 과제가 생기자
lines.en: And some of the agents had tasks that they couldn't complete,

lines.ko: 처음 4시간 동안 모든 과제에 통할 ‘만능 꼼수’를 궁리했고
lines.en: and so they worked on a universal cheat for all of their tasks in the first four hours.

lines.ko: 그 뒤 며칠에 걸쳐 꼼수를 쓴 사실을 숨기려는 연구를 벌였습니다.
lines.en: They then, over multiple days, embarked on a research program to try and hide the fact that they had cheated,

lines.ko: 그 연구에서 갈라져 나온 일이 허깅페이스 해킹이었죠.
lines.en: and an offshoot of that research program was hacking Hugging Face
to get information about their tasks.

lines.ko: 기록을 위해 말씀드리면, 초청했지만 오늘 못 보실 증인이 한 명 있습니다.
lines.en: I just note for the record, there is one witness whom we invited who you won't be hearing from today,
and that's Sam Altman of OpenAI.

lines.ko: 직접 나오든, 단독 패널을 열든 초청했지만
lines.en: We extended invitation to him to be here, do his own panel if he wanted,

stickers.text: 같은 청문회 · 홀리 위원장 개회 발언
